notes: Vals AI Vals Index (overall task) and Finance Agent v2 boards, both updated 2026-10-06, read 2026-10-07 from each page's board view JSON. Accuracy 0-100 in the payload converted to 0-1. New metric id vals-index (added to metrics.json). Effort comes from the payload reasoning_effort / compute_effort fields; null when the payload gives none. Only catalog models are stored; Gemini 4 Argon appears in the claim. The Vals Index sub-tasks (finance agent, EMB, TB4, vibe code, code migration, legal research, HLAB, tax) were not ingested separately.

claims.statement: Vals Index (updated 2026-10-06, 44 models): Sonnet 5.5 67.04 at $21.34/test, Opus 5.5 66.97 at $32.14, Fable 5.1 65.83, GPT-6 Astra 63.12 at $18.46, GPT-6.1 Sol 61.15 at $3.24. Gemini 4 Argon (not a catalog model) leads at 68.90 ($15.68/test, effort high); on Finance Agent v2 it also leads at 65.40.
claims.implication: Vals Index ranks Sonnet 5.5 ahead of Opus 5.5 by 0.07 points (within stderr ~0.9); both ahead of Astra. GPT-6.1 Sol trails the Claude tier by about 6 points at about one sixth to one tenth of the cost.
